Chapter 746 - 746 Chaos; Sorrow!

Chapter 746 - 746 Chaos; Sorrow!

746 Chaos; Sorrow!

Even though he had such thoughts, Lin Fan didn’t do it in the end.

Little Rock, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann walked out of the Coiling Dragon Villa happily.

When they saw the lively scene outside, their eyes lit up.

They looked here and touched there. Their faces were full of curiosity, as if they were Granny Liu entering the Grand View Garden.

This was normal. Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann hadn’t left the Coiling Dragon Villa for hundreds of years.

Little Rock had never left the house ever since he was born.

They first spent a year on Earth.

Then, they began to select geniuses and prepare to nurture them.

Initially, no one paid attention to the four of them.

However, when they displayed their powerful strength, it immediately caused a sensation around the world. Many people regarded them as immortals and worshipped them. The name of the Coiling Dragon Villa once again resounded throughout the world.

….

On the other hand.

After Tai Ba and Pu Guo fought, the Buddha Realm and the Demon Realm were completely severed. The flames of war quickly swept through dozens of universes.

In just a few years, countless planets had turned into ashes. It was extremely terrifying.

In the distant starry sky.

The white-robed Tao Qian kept fiddling with his fingers as he muttered,”Where did Earth go? I can’t calculate it at all. Strange.”

“A good seedling who has mastered the power of time. This is definitely a rare good disciple.”

Tao Qian was extremely annoyed.

“Ang!”

At this moment, a gust of demonic wind and a mysterious Buddhist voice suddenly rose in the sky.

It turned out to be a battle between a great Buddha and a great demon.

The sun and moon lost their color, and the space shattered. It was extremely terrifying.

“Boom!”

A beam of energy shot out, instantly blasting a planet not far away into pieces. It was like fireworks blooming, incomparably gorgeous.

Seeing this…

Tao Qian’s pupils contracted slightly.

He seemed to have thought of something and shouted angrily,”Buddha Realm, Demon Realm, you must have destroyed Earth and killed my good disciple. You deserve to die!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Tao Qian raised his hand and a long sword appeared in the air. He suddenly swung it.

“Puchi!”

Sword energy whistled.

The buddha and the great demon were neatly split in the middle.

In the end, it was blown away by the wind like a bubble.

Even so, Tao Qian still couldn’t vent his anger. He said angrily,””They killed my good disciple. I can’t let this go!”

“Don’t they want to fight? Alright, then let them fight to their heart’s content!”

In the next moment…

With Tao Qian as the center, countless people of different heights, sizes, and appearances suddenly appeared.

They leaped in all directions, turning into phantoms and disappearing without a trace.

Not long after…

Many rumors began to spread in the cosmos.

First, the Heart of the Saint Monster King had appeared in the Demon Realm. After using it, one could become a Saint King in one fell swoop. Some people had even described the origin, appearance, and aura of the Heart of a Saint King to perfection.

Second, the Saint Buddha King’s sarira had appeared in the Buddha Realm. It could possess all of the Saint Buddha King’s Dharmic powers as well as an all-round defense. Once it recognized a master, the Holy Master would not be able to harm it at all.

3. After devouring demons, one’s cultivation can increase by a large amount. Their bones and skin can be used to make weapons.

Fourth, refining the Buddha could prevent Qi deviation, increase one’s cultivation, increase one’s lifespan, and speed up one’s breakthrough…

….

Countless rumors swept through the universe like a storm.

There were many different kinds of rumors.

The same thing was that they all pointed to the demons and the Buddha.

In the beginning, no one believed these rumors.

After all, there were too many rumors.

However, he didn’t believe it the first time, the second time, the third time…

When this rumor appeared in their ears countless times, many people began to waver.

In addition, the Demon Realm and the Buddha Realm had been fighting non-stop recently. There were often heavily injured Buddhas and demons appearing in front of them.

Some people started to think.

When they found out that some of the rumors were true through experiments, they immediately became interested in the Buddha and the demons.

Gradually, they started to secretly hunt the weaker demons and Buddhas instead of the injured ones.

In the end, many black markets even had missions to hunt demons and Buddhas.

For a moment…

The Buddha and the demons became the targets of everyone’s hunt.

From star traveller level to star level, domain lord level, universe level, king level, emperor level… After that, several Sacred Lords joined the battle.

An unprecedented chaos unfolded.

….

The Temple of Life, which had always maintained a neutral stance, didn’t stay out of this.

On one hand, it was because the battle between the great demon and the great Buddha had affected the Temple of Life.

On the other hand, the Temple Master of the Temple of Life and even the Sacred Lord of Life were interested in the treasures of the Buddha Realm and the Demon Realm.

Thus, the Temple of Life had the Holy Sons and Holy Maidens enter secret realms and planets to secretly rob and kill the Buddhas and demons.

On this day, Kathleen, Lisa, Els, Mike, the two Holy Maidens, and the two Holy Sons each brought 1000 disciples of the Temple of Life to a planet called Red Medicine.

Walking on the soft ground, Kathleen couldn’t help but glance at the slender figure in the east.

It was Lisa.

She and Kathleen used to be best sisters.

They ate together, showered together, played together…They knew each other better than he did.

However, everything changed after she received the powerful skill from Lin Fan.

This was because Lisa was naturally talented.

Her wish was to become the next Temple Master of the Temple of Life, and she had been working hard for it.

However, on that day, after Kathleen used the Life Combat Technique, she became the brightest star of the Temple of Life, surpassing all the Saints and Saintesses.

Although Kathleen had explained that this powerful cultivation technique was taught to her by an expert in the River of Time, she was still able to use it.

But Lisa didn’t believe it.

She felt that Kathleen had been hiding her true self so that she would let her guard down and step on her.

What cultivation technique taught by an expert in the River of Time?

Simply ridiculous!

Cultivation techniques were the most important thing for everyone.

How could he give it to others so easily?

Moreover, it was such a powerful life cultivation technique.

In this world, other than the Temple of Life, there was no other place.

Kathleen must have obtained a cultivation technique from a secret realm in the Temple of Life and secretly cultivated it for countless years.

It was laughable that she still treated her as her best sister.

The more Lisa thought about it, the more she hated Kathleen.

The two of them gradually became strangers, and even their eyes were red with envy.

Kathleen looked at Lisa’s cold back and recalled many things about the two of them.

In the end, it turned into a long sigh.

“Rumble!”

At this moment, the entire ground shook violently like an earthquake.

Everyone became alert.
